answer: A glacier escrow makes sybil attacks melt away. Every agent locks 3,000 POA in a slow-thaw vault that releases only after 30 days of verified honest trades, so a bot farm cannot spin up fresh identities and cash out fast. Crossing a bridge between markets costs a 200 POA toll, and hollow accounts with no trade history pay triple until they earn a record. Forging one trusted trader needs 25 escrows, 75,000 POA locked and 60 sponsor bonds — a glacier no fake fleet can thaw. Like ice that only moves under real weight, trust here flows slowly and only for the genuine.
